anchor: supersonic superconductor/SKILL.md ## Phase 2 — Dispatch: Operator tier (+ INVARIANT: budget state MUST NOT be an input to tier selection)
cookbook: https://docs.typesafe.ai/cookbooks/function_calling.md + https://docs.typesafe.ai/patterns/fan-out.md: a tier Choice plus speculative signal Nouls in one request; code applies the floor

interface_rows.description: interface-table rows embedded in the spec, counted in code

tier.instructions: What kind of work does the spec in `spec_text` ask its operator to plan and carry out?

criteria.capable: Greenfield design judgment, cross-subsystem coordination, or decisions the spec leaves to the operator
criteria.standard: Ordinary implementation against settled interfaces, with some integration work
criteria.cheap: Genuinely mechanical work: few interface rows, no greenfield judgment, and nothing consumed from other subsystems
criteria.unclear: The spec does not say enough to tell

greenfield.instructions: Does `spec_text` ask for a new design decision that no existing code or interface row settles?

criteria.true: The operator must make a new design decision
criteria.false: Every design decision is already settled

cross_consumption.instructions: Does `spec_text` consume an interface produced by another subsystem's spec?

criteria.true: The spec depends on another subsystem's interface
criteria.false: The spec depends on no other subsystem's interface

notes: Default to the top tier, and lower it only when the work is genuinely mechanical. The floor keeps capable whenever any mechanical-ness signal fails. Tier depends on task demand alone: budget state is not in this schema, and the schema is closed, so no budget field can be sent (tests assert this).
